related.title: vLLM 連續批次：Little定律與入場控制
related.titleEn: vLLM continuous batching: Little law and admission
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：期望模型假設明示，分布修正經驗證，速度以真正提交token計算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Assumptions are explicit, distribution correction validated, and speed counts committed tokens.
related.difference: 使用同一系統邊界量測到達率與逗留時間，推導平均在系統請求數。
related.differenceEn: Measure arrival rate and residence time within one boundary to derive average requests in system.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 常數獨立接受率α、γ個草稿及一個額外輸出時，每回合理想期望Σ(k=0..γ)α^k；只是簡化模型。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 γ3、α0.8，先不計草稿與驗證時間差；分布保持另需正確演算法。 期望=1+0.8+0.64+0.512=2.952 token/回合。
穩定系統Little定律L=λW；W須包含邊界內等待與處理，不能混用只計算時間。 以下數值均為合成教學條件，不是來源產品的規格或實測成績。 教學λ12請求/s、平均W2.5 s，無長期積壓增長；請求長度分布固定。 平均在系統L=12×2.5=30請求，不等於硬體每一時刻的batch大小。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With independent constant acceptanceα,γ drafts and one extra output, ideal expected output isΣα^k for k0..γ. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. γ3,α0.8, initially excluding draft/verification timing; distribution preservation requires the correct algorithm. Expected output=2.952 tokens/round.

For a stable system, L=λW; W includes waiting and service within the chosen boundary. All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. Teachingλ12 requests/s, W2.5 s, no growing backlog and fixed length distribution. AverageL30 requests, not instantaneous hardware batch size.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: GoogLeNet Inception：瓶頸與多尺度分支
related.titleEn: GoogLeNet Inception: bottlenecks and multiscale branches
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：期望模型假設明示，分布修正經驗證，速度以真正提交token計算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Assumptions are explicit, distribution correction validated, and speed counts committed tokens.
related.difference: 畫64→16→32通道支路，並與另一路32通道在相同H,W串成64通道。；兩份MAC表吻合，分支空間尺寸一致；若瓶頸品質下降超教學2百分點則拒絕。
related.differenceEn: Draw64→16→32 channels and concatenate with another32-channel branch at the same H,W to form64 channels.; MAC sheets agree and branch spatial sizes match; reject if the teaching quality loss exceeds2 percentage points.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

1×1降維再3×3的每位置MAC=CinB+9BCout；分支串接沿通道軸。；教學Cin=64、瓶頸B=16、Cout=32，省略偏置與激活。；MAC=64×16+9×16×32=5632；B=8時2816。直接3×3為18432。

All numbers below are synthetic teaching conditions, not specifications or measured results of the cited product. γ3,α0.8, initially excluding draft/verification timing; distribution preservation requires the correct algorithm. Expected output=2.952 tokens/round.
